summary: PASS — Cosmetic transcript fix verified end-to-end. The added `response.output_audio_transcript.delta` branch in frontend/src/hooks/use-realtime-voice.ts (lines 198-205) now populates the on-screen assistant transcript bubbles in real time while audio plays. Previously bubbles stayed as `…` placeholders; now they grow character-by-character and end non-empty. E2E `query_dashboard` flow also re-verified: 'kitne shipments pending hain?' produced the assistant bubble 'Sir, 1 shipment pending hai.' containing the exact number '1' returned by /api/voice/query. Both required tests pass; no regressions introduced. No code was modified during this iteration.

minor_followups.issue: A stale empty assistant bubble (rendered as `…`) can linger when `response.created` fires but the model produces zero deltas (e.g. VAD-triggered empty response). Consider stripping/removing turns whose content is still empty at `response.done` (or `response.cancelled`) instead of just flipping isFinal. Cosmetic only — audio & other bubbles work correctly.

During the test the model emitted multiple unsolicited follow-up assistant turns (e.g. 'Sir, main wait kar raha hoon...', 'Main yahan hoon, ready Sir.') presumably because server VAD interpreted silence/background audio as fresh user turns. Not caused by this fix. Consider tightening VAD threshold or gating auto-responses when no user transcript is produced.
